name: scholarsync-mcp-academic-server
description: A local academic MCP server for ScholarSync notes, assignments, PDFs, tasks, timetable, and MongoDB-backed student data.
long_description: ScholarSync MCP Academic Server is a local MCP server that lets Claude interact with academic resources through structured tools. It can search notes, ingest notes and PDFs into semantic chunks, retrieve academic context with vector-style search, summarize PDFs, manage assignments, track reminders, inspect schedules, and query MongoDB collections.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search academic notes by topic, keyword, subject, or concept from MongoDB and local text notes.

tools.name: retrieve_academic_context
tools.description: Retrieve notes and study context before answering academic questions using semantic RAG with keyword fallback.

tools.name: ingest_academic_knowledge_base
tools.description: Chunk notes and PDFs, embed them, and store semantic retrieval documents in MongoDB.

tools.name: semantic_search_academic_knowledge
tools.description: Run semantic vector-style search across ingested academic notes and PDF chunks.

tools.name: summarize_pdf
tools.description: Extract study PDF text from the pdfs folder and return content Claude can summarize into key points.

tools.name: search_assignments
tools.description: Search assignments by subject, due date, priority, status, or text query.

tools.name: add_assignment
tools.description: Add a new academic assignment with subject, title, due date, priority, and completion status.

tools.name: update_assignment_status
tools.description: Update an assignment status, such as pending, in progress, completed, or overdue.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Get classes from the timetable for today, tomorrow, a weekday, or a specific subject.

tools.name: get_subject_info
tools.description: Get subject/course information such as faculty, credits, syllabus, or timetable details.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add an academic task or reminder with optional due date, subject, priority, and notes.

tools.name: view_tasks
tools.description: View academic tasks and reminders by status, date, subject, or text query.

tools.name: mark_task_complete
tools.description: Mark an academic task or reminder as completed.

tools.name: query_student_database
tools.description: Safely query MongoDB academic collections when a direct database lookup is needed.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check MCP server and MongoDB connectivity for debugging.

tools.name: generate_exam_questions
tools.description: Retrieve academic context for a subject/topic and instruct Claude to generate practice exam questions (MCQ, short answer, or true/false).

tools.name: create_study_plan
tools.description: Gather upcoming assignments, tasks, and timetable data so Claude can create a personalised study plan for the next N days.

tools.name: find_knowledge_gaps
tools.description: Identify subjects where the student has assignments but few or no ingested notes, flagging knowledge gaps that need more study material.

tools.name: get_urgent_items
tools.description: Find assignments and tasks due within the next N hours so Claude can proactively warn the student about upcoming deadlines.

tools.name: translate_and_search
tools.description: Detect the language of a query, translate it to English, and search academic content. Use this when the student asks in Hindi, Marathi, or any non-English language.
